title: maint.event.v1
description: Phase 6.3 + Phase 8: maintenance-plane event bus. `kind` is an open enum (ROADMAP §7.4/§8.9); per-kind sub-schemas live under `maint.event.v1/<kind>.json`. The base schema validates the envelope shape only; per-kind fields are validated by the sub-schema discriminated on `kind`.

kind.description: Open enum (ROADMAP §8.9). Producer-side closed set is KNOWN_MAINT_EVENT_KINDS in `ai/swarm/agents/maint/_ack_routing.py`; per-kind sub-schemas live under `ai/swarm/sdk/schemas/maint.event.v1/<kind>.json`.
